    # BankShield V1 (MongoDB)
    
    ## Configure MongoDB Atlas
    
    1. Create an Atlas project and cluster, then create a **database user** for the app.
    2. Add the machine or hosting provider's outbound IP address to the project's IP access list. Atlas requires both an allowed IP and a database user.
    3. In the cluster's **Connect > Drivers** panel, copy the Node.js connection string.
    4. Put the connection string in `MONGODB_URI` in `.env`; set a strong, unique `ADMIN_USERNAME`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD`, and a random `SESSION_SECRET` of at least 32 characters. Keep `.env` private; it is ignored by Git.
    
    ## Run the app
    
    From this `V1` directory:
    
    ```powershell
     if (!(Test-Path .env)) { Copy-Item .env.example .env }
     npm install
     npm start
    ```
    
    Then open `http://localhost:3000/`. Open `http://localhost:3000/admin.html` for the admin portal. MongoDB database `bankshield` is selected by default. On first server startup the app creates the quiz settings document and required indexes; attempts and submitted results are written to MongoDB collections. No manual schema migration is needed.
    
    Set `MONGODB_DB` if you want another database name. When deploying, add the same environment variables in the host's secret/environment settings and allow that host's outbound IP in Atlas. Deploy this as a Node.js service; a static HTML host cannot run the API.
    
    Multiple choice questions award partial credit equal to correct selected choices divided by the number of correct choices. Incorrect selections do not subtract marks. Other automatically graded formats award 1 or 0. Written responses use the existing keyword matching and remain flagged for admin review.

    function correctAnswer(q, a) {

      else if (q.type === 'match') correct = Array.isArray(a) && a.length === q.answer.length && a.every((v,i) => v === q.answer[i]);
      else if (q.type === 'branch') correct = Array.isArray(a) && a.length === 3 && a.every(x => q.nodes.find(n => n.id === x.node)?.answer === x.choice);

        fontDecrease: 'à¤«à¤¼à¥‰à¤¨à¥à¤Ÿ à¤†à¤•à¤¾à¤° à¤˜à¤Ÿà¤¾à¤à¤',
        fontReset: 'à¤«à¤¼à¥‰à¤¨à¥à¤Ÿ à¤†à¤•à¤¾à¤° à¤¸à¤¾à¤®à¤¾à¤¨à¥à¤¯ à¤•à¤°à¥‡à¤‚',
        evidenceFields: { title: 'à¤¶à¥€à¤°à¥à¤·à¤•', from: 'à¤ªà¥à¤°à¥‡à¤·à¤•', link: 'à¤²à¤¿à¤‚à¤•', request: 'à¤…à¤¨à¥à¤°à¥‹à¤§', tone: 'à¤²à¤¹à¤œà¤¾', 'reply-to': 'à¤œà¤µà¤¾à¤¬ à¤•à¤¾ à¤ªà¤¤à¤¾' }
      };
      let language = 'en';
      const text = (key, english) => language === 'hi' ? (UI()[key] || EXTRA[key] || english) : english;
    
      function localizeQuestion(question) {
        if (language !== 'hi') return question;
        const hi = (window.__HINDI_MAP || {})[question.id];
        if (!hi) return question;
        const q = { ...question };
        if (hi.topic_hi) q.topic = hi.topic_hi;
        if (hi.formatLabel_hi) q.formatLabel = hi.formatLabel_hi;
        if (hi.prompt_hi) q.prompt = hi.prompt_hi;
        if (hi.explanation_hi) q.explanation = hi.explanation_hi;
        if (Array.isArray(hi.options_hi)) q.options = hi.options_hi;
        if (Array.isArray(hi.left_hi)) q.left = hi.left_hi;
        if (Array.isArray(hi.right_hi)) q.right = hi.right_hi;
        if (hi.evidence_hi && q.evidence) q.evidence = hi.evidence_hi;
        if (Array.isArray(hi.nodes_hi) && q.nodes) {
          q.nodes = q.nodes.map(node => {
            const translated = hi.nodes_hi.find(item => item.id === node.id);
            if (!translated) return node;
            return {
              ...node,
              prompt: translated.prompt_hi || node.prompt,
              options: node.options.map((option, index) => ({
                ...option,
                text: translated.options_hi?.[index]?.text_hi || option.text
              }))
            };
          });
        }
        return q;
      }

        const placeholders = [['#full-name','phFullName'],['#department','phDept'],['#branch','phBranch'],['#email','phEmail']];
        placeholders.forEach(([selector,key]) => { const el=document.querySelector(selector); if(el){if(!el.dataset.english)el.dataset.english=el.placeholder;el.placeholder=isHindi?(UI()[key]||el.dataset.english):el.dataset.english;} });

          }

        const scaleKey = 'bankshield_font_scale';
        let fontScale = 1;
        try { fontScale = Number(localStorage.getItem(scaleKey)) || 1; } catch (_) {}
        const setFontScale = value => {
          fontScale = Math.max(0.8, Math.min(1.5, Math.round(value * 10) / 10));
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--font-scale', String(fontScale));
          try { localStorage.setItem(scaleKey, String(fontScale)); } catch (_) {}
          const smaller = document.getElementById('font-decrease');
          const larger = document.getElementById('font-increase');
          if (smaller) smaller.disabled = fontScale <= 0.8;
          if (larger) larger.disabled = fontScale >= 1.5;
        };
        document.getElementById('font-decrease')?.addEventListener('click', () => setFontScale(fontScale - 0.1));
        document.getElementById('font-increase')?.addEventListener('click', () => setFontScale(fontScale + 0.1));
        document.getElementById('font-reset')?.addEventListener('click', () => setFontScale(1));
        setFontScale(fontScale);
        let saved = 'en';
        try { saved = localStorage.getItem('bankshield_lang') || 'en'; } catch (_) {}
        setLanguage(saved);
      });
    })();

    # BankShield V1 (MongoDB)
    
    ## Configure MongoDB Atlas
    
    1. Create an Atlas project and cluster, then create a **database user** for the app.
    2. Add the machine or hosting provider's outbound IP address to the project's IP access list. Atlas requires both an allowed IP and a database user.
    3. In the cluster's **Connect > Drivers** panel, copy the Node.js connection string.
    4. Put the connection string in `MONGODB_URI` in `.env`; set a strong, unique `ADMIN_USERNAME`, `ADMIN_PASSWORD`, and a random `SESSION_SECRET` of at least 32 characters. Keep `.env` private; it is ignored by Git.
    
    ## Run the app
    
    From this `V1` directory:
    
    ```powershell
     if (!(Test-Path .env)) { Copy-Item .env.example .env }
     npm install
     npm start
    ```
    
    Then open `http://localhost:3000/`. Open `http://localhost:3000/admin.html` for the admin portal. MongoDB database `bankshield` is selected by default. On first server startup the app creates the quiz settings document and required indexes; attempts and submitted results are written to MongoDB collections. No manual schema migration is needed.
    
    Set `MONGODB_DB` if you want another database name. When deploying, add the same environment variables in the host's secret/environment settings and allow that host's outbound IP in Atlas. Deploy this as a Node.js service; a static HTML host cannot run the API.
    
    Multiple choice questions award partial credit equal to correct selected choices divided by the number of correct choices. Incorrect selections do not subtract marks. Other automatically graded formats award 1 or 0. Written responses use the existing keyword matching and remain flagged for admin review.

## Assistant

Yes. MongoDB Atlas offers a **free shared cluster** with **512 MB of storage**, which may be enough for a small assessment database like this one. The free tier has operational limits, and Atlas automatically pauses an inactive free cluster after 30 days. [Atlas pricing](https://www.mongodb.com/pricing), [free-cluster limits](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/free-shared-limitations/), [pause policy](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/pause-terminate-cluster/)

Atlas hosts the database, though; it doesn’t host this app’s Node.js server. The app would still need to run on your computer or a separate hosting service.

## Assistant

Here’s how to set up Atlas’s free shared cluster for this app:

1. Sign up or sign in at [MongoDB Atlas](https://cloud.mongodb.com/).
2. Create a project, then choose **Create** and select the **M0 Free** cluster option. Pick an available cloud provider and region, and give the cluster a name. Atlas says free clusters are suitable for small development projects and don’t expire. [Atlas setup guide](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/tutorial/deploy-free-tier-cluster/)
3. Create a **database user** with a username and password. This is separate from your Atlas website login.
4. Add your current IP address to the project’s **IP Access List**. Atlas only accepts connections from IPs on that list. If you later host the app elsewhere, add the hosting service’s outbound IP too. [Atlas connection guide](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/connect-to-database-deployment/)
5. In the cluster, click **Connect → Drivers**, select **Node.js**, and copy the connection string. Replace `<password>` with the database user’s password. If it contains reserved characters like `@`, URL encode them (for example, `@` becomes `%40`).
6. In `D:\V1\.env`, set `MONGODB_URI` to that connection string. Leave `MONGODB_DB=bankshield`; the app uses that database name by default. Keep `.env` private.
7. From `D:\V1`, run `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000/`. If the connection fails, first check that your current IP is on the Atlas access list and the username/password are correct.

The free cluster hosts the database; the Node app still needs to run on your computer or a separate app host.

## Assistant

For this auditorium quiz, I’d deploy the **Node.js app and MongoDB Atlas database before the event**, then run a full rehearsal using the room’s Wi‑Fi and an attendee-sized group.

This app uses an Express server, MongoDB, and admin sessions. The main risk during a live test is a cold start or connectivity issue: everyone needs to open the quiz and submit results successfully. A free plan can work for a small, low-stakes event, but I wouldn’t rely on it for an event where a delay or lost submissions would disrupt the program.

**Recommended setup:**

- Host the Node app on a service that supports a persistent Node process. Render supports web services, but its free service can sleep after 15 minutes idle and take about a minute to wake; its filesystem is ephemeral. That’s manageable if you wake it and verify it shortly before the quiz, but keep results in Atlas, as this app does. [Render free service limits](https://render.com/docs/free)
- Use Atlas for MongoDB. Its free cluster has limits, including a 512 MB storage cap and automatic pause after 30 days without connections. [Atlas free-cluster limits](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/free-shared-limitations/)
- For an important live event, consider paying for a hosting plan that won’t sleep. Vercel can run Express through a function, but that changes the app’s runtime model and needs careful rehearsal; I wouldn’t choose it as the quickest path for this existing server. [Vercel Express deployment](https://vercel.com/docs/frameworks/backend/express)

**Before the event:** publish the site, confirm the admin dashboard works, run a complete practice quiz, verify that submissions appear in the dashboard and export, test with several phones on the actual auditorium Wi‑Fi, and have a backup plan such as a QR code plus a way to collect responses if connectivity fails.

Hosting and database availability aren’t the only constraints: auditorium Wi‑Fi must handle everyone connecting at once. If attendance is large, ask the venue or IT team about capacity and a guest network in advance.

## User

what about hosting the site locally on LAN, and making all the attendees first connect the local network? will the laptop handle the load?

## Assistant

Yes, hosting it on a laptop over a local network can work well for a one-time auditorium quiz. Attendees join the same Wi‑Fi, scan a QR code with the laptop’s local address, and the quiz can run without relying on internet access during the event.

**Your laptop can probably handle a modest group.** This app serves static pages and makes a few small API requests per candidate. The bigger uncertainty is usually the auditorium network and Wi‑Fi access point, not the laptop. I can’t say it will handle everyone reliably without knowing the number of attendees and the network setup.

For a live event, use a dedicated router or access point with enough capacity, connect the laptop to it by Ethernet if possible, and make sure attendee Wi‑Fi can reach the laptop. Campus or corporate guest networks often isolate clients, which would prevent phones from reaching the quiz server even when they’re on the same Wi‑Fi.

One important detail: **the current app still requires MongoDB to start**. Its server connects to Atlas at startup and saves results there. So a fully offline LAN setup would need a local database or a code change. With Atlas, the LAN quiz still needs internet access from the laptop to reach the database.

Before the event, test using the actual laptop, router, and room network with a group about the size of the audience. Check that phones can load the quiz, start and finish it, and that results appear in the admin dashboard. Also arrange a backup connection or response method in case the network fails.

## Assistant

The questions are stored in [server/question-bank.json](/D:/V1/server/question-bank.json). The server reads this file when it starts, then selects questions for each candidate from that pool.

To add a question, add another JSON object to the array in that file. Give it a unique `id`, a `topic`, a supported `type`, the prompt and options, the correct `answer`, an `explanation`, and a `formatLabel`. For a basic multiple choice question, use `"type": "single"` and set `answer` to the **zero-based** option index: `0` for the first option, `1` for the second, and so on.

The app also supports `multi`, `match`, `order`, `written`, `correction`, `branch`, `diff`, and `tabletop` question types, each with its own data shape. Follow an existing question of the same type as a template. If you want the new question to appear in Hindi, add its translation to [lang_hi.js](/D:/V1/lang_hi.js) too.

After editing, restart the server so it reloads the file. Check that the JSON remains valid, that the ID is unique, and that the admin’s configured question count doesn’t exceed the pool size.

## User

in the admin dashboard, in the candidate's result, is the marks only thing stored? or do we have option to see what all questions did each candidate answer. like analyze where each candidate went wrong

## Assistant

The admin dashboard stores **more than just marks**. For each candidate, it saves the score and a per question record containing:

- The question, topic, and type
- The candidate’s answer and the correct answer
- Whether it was marked correct and how many points were awarded
- An explanation, and a flag for written answers that need manual review

In the dashboard, use **View responses** on a candidate’s result to inspect their answers and see where they went wrong. The admin page also exports the question by question responses to Excel.

    admin.html:6:</head><body><header class="topbar"><div class="brand"><div class="mark">B</div><div>BankShield<small>Administrator portal</small></div></div><div class="topnote">Shared server submissions</div></header><main class="wrap"><section class="panel panel-pad adminbox"><div class="admin-header-row"><div><div class="kicker">Administrator</div><h2 style="margin:4px 0 2px">Admin Dashboard</h2><p class="muted" style="margin:0">Unlock to view candidate scores and export submissions.</p></div><div class="admin-lock-row"><input id="admin-pin" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Enter admin PIN" aria-label="Administrator PIN" style="border:1px solid #d5e0e9;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;width:200px;font:inherit;outline:none"><button class="btn primary" id="admin-unlock-btn" type="button">Unlock</button></div></div><p class="tiny" id="admin-status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:8px">Enter the administrator PIN configured on the server.</p><div id="admin-dashboard" class="hidden"><div class="dash-stats" id="dash-stats"></div><div class="dash-toolbar"><input id="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="Search by name, branch, department..." class="dash-search-input"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn secondary" id="export-btn" type="button">Export Excel</button><button class="btn danger" id="clear-btn" type="button">Clear records</button></div></div><div class="dash-table-wrap"><table class="dash-table" id="dash-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Branch</th><th>Email</th><th>Score</th><th>%</th><th>Grade</th><th>Duration</th><th>Submitted</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="dash-tbody"></tbody></table><p id="dash-empty" class="dash-empty hidden">No submissions found on this server.</p></div></div></section></main><script>
    admin.html:10:async function loadRecords(){const response=await fetch('/api/admin/submissions');if(!response.ok)throw new Error('Could not load submissions. Sign in again.');return response.json();}
    admin.html:19:function createXlsx(records){const attempts=[['Submission ID','Started at (UTC)','Submitted at (UTC)','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Score (admin only)','Out of','Percentage (admin only)','Duration (seconds)','Submission status','Questions answered']];const details=[['Submission ID','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Submitted at (UTC)','Question #','Pool ID','Topic','Question type','Question','Candidate response','Correct answer (admin only)','Auto-graded correct?','Written response needs manual review?','Explanation (admin only)']];for(const r of records){attempts.push([r.submissionId,r.startedAt,r.completedAt,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.score,r.scoreOutOf,r.percent,r.durationSeconds,r.status,r.responses.filter(x=>x.candidateAnswer!=='Not answered').length]);for(const d of r.responses)details.push([r.submissionId,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.completedAt,d.questionNumber,d.questionId,d.topic,d.type,d.prompt,d.candidateAnswer,d.correctAnswer,d.correct?'Yes':'No',d.writtenNeedsReview?'Yes':'No',d.explanation]);}
    admin.html:20: const notes=[['BankShield assessment results — administrator workbook'],['Purpose','Stores candidate details, internal scores, and per-question answer records for submissions saved on this server.'],['Data scope','This export includes all submissions saved on this server. Review those responses manually before making decisions.'],['Privacy note','This workbook contains employee identifiers and assessment answers. Store and share it only through approved bank channels.'],['Security note','Static HTML is a pilot. The answer key is present in the page source; this design hides it from the candidate interface but is not a secure proctored testing platform.'],['Empty export','If there are no rows on the Attempts sheet, no attempts have been stored on this server.']];

## Assistant

I don’t see Git history in the current folder, so I can’t confirm which edits were made most recently. I compared it with the project at `D:\V1`: this folder appears to be a **Vercel deployment version** of the quiz.

Key differences:

- The original uses a Node/Express server, MongoDB Atlas, and server-side grading. This version replaces those with Vercel API functions and Vercel Blob storage for results. It has no MongoDB connection.
- The questions are embedded in `BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html`, and the browser selects and grades them. The answer key is therefore present in the page source.
- The quiz is fixed at 25 questions and 15 minutes. The original app allows an administrator to change those settings.
- Admin access now uses an `ADMIN_PIN` and signed cookie. Result storage and authentication helpers are in the `api` folder.
- The candidate page was renamed, and `vercel.json` routes `/` to it.

One security caveat: because candidates’ browsers receive the questions and answers and calculate scores, this version can hide answers in the interface but can’t prevent a technically curious candidate from inspecting the answer key. For a speaker-led practice quiz, that may be acceptable; for a secure assessment, grading and answer keys should stay on the server.

No files were changed.

## User

where are the candidate results stored? local or central server?

## Assistant

In the **current Vercel version**, candidate results are stored centrally in **Vercel Blob**, not in each attendee’s browser or on the laptop. The API saves each submission as a private JSON blob; the admin dashboard reads results from that storage.

The Blob storage must be configured in the Vercel deployment for saving and viewing results to work.

## User

i want to enable admin to view candidate assessments

## Assistant

I’ll inspect the current admin dashboard and results API to see whether per-question candidate answers are already available, and I’ll implement the missing view if needed.

    </head><body><header class="topbar"><div class="brand"><div class="mark">B</div><div>BankShield<small>Administrator portal</small></div></div><div class="topnote">Shared server submissions</div></header><main class="wrap"><section class="panel panel-pad adminbox"><div class="admin-header-row"><div><div class="kicker">Administrator</div><h2 style="margin:4px 0 2px">Admin Dashboard</h2><p class="muted" style="margin:0">Unlock to view candidate scores and export submissions.</p></div><div class="admin-lock-row"><input id="admin-pin" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Enter admin PIN" aria-label="Administrator PIN" style="border:1px solid #d5e0e9;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;width:200px;font:inherit;outline:none"><button class="btn primary" id="admin-unlock-btn" type="button">Unlock</button></div></div><p class="tiny" id="admin-status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:8px">Enter the administrator PIN configured on the server.</p><div id="admin-dashboard" class="hidden"><div class="dash-stats" id="dash-stats"></div><div class="dash-toolbar"><input id="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="Search by name, branch, department..." class="dash-search-input"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn secondary" id="export-btn" type="button">Export Excel</button><button class="btn danger" id="clear-btn" type="button">Clear records</button></div></div><div class="dash-table-wrap"><table class="dash-table" id="dash-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Branch</th><th>Email</th><th>Score</th><th>%</th><th>Grade</th><th>Duration</th><th>Submitted</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="dash-tbody"></tbody></table><p id="dash-empty" class="dash-empty hidden">No submissions found on this server.</p></div></div></section></main><script>
    const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
    function escapeHtml(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
    
    async function loadRecords(){const response=await fetch('/api/admin/submissions');if(!response.ok)throw new Error('Could not load submissions. Sign in again.');return response.json();}
    const crcTable=(()=>{let c,table=[];for(let n=0;n<256;n++){c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=((c&1)?(0xEDB88320^(c>>>1)):(c>>>1));table[n]=c>>>0;}return table;})();
    function crc32(bytes){let c=0xffffffff;for(const b of bytes)c=crcTable[(c^b)&0xff]^(c>>>8);return (c^0xffffffff)>>>0;}
    function u16(n){return [n&255,(n>>>8)&255];}function u32(n){return [n&255,(n>>>8)&255,(n>>>16)&255,(n>>>24)&255];}
    function concatBytes(parts){let size=parts.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.length,0),out=new Uint8Array(size),at=0;for(const p of parts){out.set(p,at);at+=p.length;}return out;}
    function zipStore(files){const enc=new TextEncoder(),locals=[],centrals=[];let offset=0;for(const f of files){const name=enc.encode(f.name),data=enc.encode(f.data),crc=crc32(data);const local=concatBytes([new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,0x03,0x04,...u16(20),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u32(crc),...u32(data.length),...u32(data.length),...u16(name.length),...u16(0)]),name,data]);locals.push(local);const central=concatBytes([new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,0x01,0x02,...u16(20),...u16(20),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u32(crc),...u32(data.length),...u32(data.length),...u16(name.length),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(0),...u32(0),...u32(offset)]),name]);centrals.push(central);offset+=local.length;}const centralBytes=concatBytes(centrals);const end=new Uint8Array([0x50,0x4b,0x05,0x06,...u16(0),...u16(0),...u16(files.length),...u16(files.length),...u32(centralBytes.length),...u32(offset),...u16(0)]);return concatBytes([...locals,centralBytes,end]);}
    function colName(n){let s='';while(n>0){let r=(n-1)%26;s=String.fromCharCode(65+r)+s;n=Math.floor((n-1)/26);}return s;}
    function xlsxCell(value,row,col,header=false){const ref=colName(col+1)+row;const st=header?' s="1"':'';if(value===null||value===undefined||value==='')return `<c r="${ref}"${st} t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>`;if(typeof value==='number'&&Number.isFinite(value))return `<c r="${ref}"${st}><v>${value}</v></c>`;const s=String(value).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/\n/g,'&#10;');return `<c r="${ref}"${st} t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${s}</t></is></c>`;}
    function sheetXml(rows){const cols=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r.length));const xmlRows=rows.map((r,i)=>`<row r="${i+1}">${Array.from({length:cols},(_,c)=>xlsxCell(r[c],i+1,c,i===0)).join('')}</row>`).join('');return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><sheetViews><sheetView workbookViewId="0"><pane ySplit="1" topLeftCell="A2" activePane="bottomLeft" state="frozen"/></sheetView></sheetViews><sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="18"/><sheetData>${xmlRows}</sheetData><autoFilter ref="A1:${colName(cols)}${rows.length}"/><pageMargins left="0.25" right="0.25" top="0.5" bottom="0.5" header="0.2" footer="0.2"/></worksheet>`;}
    function createXlsx(records){const attempts=[['Submission ID','Started at (UTC)','Submitted at (UTC)','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Score (admin only)','Out of','Percentage (admin only)','Duration (seconds)','Submission status','Questions answered']];const details=[['Submission ID','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Submitted at (UTC)','Question #','Pool ID','Topic','Question type','Question','Candidate response','Correct answer (admin only)','Auto-graded correct?','Written response needs manual review?','Explanation (admin only)']];for(const r of records){attempts.push([r.submissionId,r.startedAt,r.completedAt,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.score,r.scoreOutOf,r.percent,r.durationSeconds,r.status,r.responses.filter(x=>x.candidateAnswer!=='Not answered').length]);for(const d of r.responses)details.push([r.submissionId,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.completedAt,d.questionNumber,d.questionId,d.topic,d.type,d.prompt,d.candidateAnswer,d.correctAnswer,d.correct?'Yes':'No',d.writtenNeedsReview?'Yes':'No',d.explanation]);}
     const notes=[['BankShield assessment results â€” administrator workbook'],['Purpose','Stores candidate details, internal scores, and per-question answer records for submissions saved on this server.'],['Data scope','This export includes all submissions saved on this server. All attempts submitted to this server are included.'],['Scoring note','Written-response and error-correction answers use basic keyword checks only. Review those responses manually before making decisions.'],['Privacy note','This workbook contains employee identifiers and assessment answers. Store and share it only through approved bank channels.'],['Security note','Static HTML is a pilot. The answer key is present in the page source; this design hides it from the candidate interface but is not a secure proctored testing platform.'],['Empty export','If there are no rows on the Attempts sheet, no attempts have been stored on this server.']];
     const files=[
      {name:'[Content_Types].xml',data:'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="xml" ContentType="application/xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/workbook.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/><Override PartName="/xl/styles.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.styles+xml"/></Types>'},
      {name:'_rels/.rels',data:'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument" Target="xl/workbook.xml"/></Relationships>'},
      {name:'xl/workbook.xml',data:'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><workbook xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"><bookViews><workbookView/></bookViews><sheets><sheet name="Attempts" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/><sheet name="Response Detail" sheetId="2" r:id="rId2"/><sheet name="Read Me" sheetId="3" r:id="rId3"/></sheets></workbook>'},
      {name:'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels',data:'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet2.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId3" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet3.xml"/><Relationship Id="rId4" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/></Relationships>'},
      {name:'xl/styles.xml',data:'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><styleSheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"><fonts count="2"><font><sz val="11"/><name val="Aptos"/></font><font><b/><color rgb="FFFFFFFF"/><sz val="11"/><name val="Aptos"/></font></fonts><fills count="3"><fill><patternFill patternType="none"/></fill><fill><patternFill patternType="gray125"/></fill><fill><patternFill patternType="solid"><fgColor rgb="FF173D5B"/><bgColor indexed="64"/></patternFill></fill></fills><borders count="1"><border><left/><right/><top/><bottom/><diagonal/></border></borders><cellStyleXfs count="1"><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0"/></cellStyleXfs><cellXfs count="2"><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" xfId="0"/><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="2" borderId="0" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyFill="1"/></cellXfs><cellStyles count="1"><cellStyle name="Normal" xfId="0" builtinId="0"/></cellStyles></styleSheet>'},
      {name:'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml',data:sheetXml(attempts)},

    function gradeInfo(pct){
      if(pct>=80)return{label:'Pass',cls:'grade-pass',barColor:'#177850'};
      if(pct>=60)return{label:'Merit',cls:'grade-merit',barColor:'#1a4ea6'};
      return{label:'Fail',cls:'grade-fail',barColor:'#b13e48'};
    }
    
    function fmtDuration(secs){
      const m=Math.floor(secs/60),s=secs%60;
      return `${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2,'0')}s`;
    }
    
    function fmtDate(iso){
      try{const d=new Date(iso);return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'})+' '+d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}catch{return iso||'â€”';}
    }
    
    function renderDashboard(records){
      // Stats
      const total=records.length;
      const passed=records.filter(r=>r.percent>=80).length;
      const avg=total?Math.round(records.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.percent,0)/total):0;
      const avgScore=total?Math.round(records.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r.score||0),0)/total*10)/10:0;
      const passRate=total?Math.round(passed/total*100):0;
      $('dash-stats').innerHTML=`
        <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">${total}</div><div class="stat-lbl">Total attempts</div></div>
        <div class="stat-card ${passRate>=60?'green':'red'}"><div class="stat-val">${passRate}%</div><div class="stat-lbl">Pass rate (â‰¥80%)</div></div>
        <div class="stat-card ${avg>=80?'green':avg>=60?'amber':'red'}"><div class="stat-val">${avg}%</div><div class="stat-lbl">Average score %</div></div>
        <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-val">${avgScore}</div><div class="stat-lbl">Avg marks (of 25)</div></div>
        <div class="stat-card green"><div class="stat-val">${passed}</div><div class="stat-lbl">Passed</div></div>
        <div class="stat-card red"><div class="stat-val">${total-passed}</div><div class="stat-lbl">Failed</div></div>
      `;
      renderTable(records);
    }
    
    function renderTable(records){
      const tbody=$('dash-tbody');
      const empty=$('dash-empty');
      if(!records.length){tbody.innerHTML='';empty.classList.remove('hidden');return;}
      empty.classList.add('hidden');
      const sorted=[...records].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.completedAt)-new Date(a.completedAt));
      tbody.innerHTML=sorted.map((r,i)=>{
        const pct=r.percent??Math.round((r.score/r.scoreOutOf)*100);
        const g=gradeInfo(pct);
        const barW=Math.min(100,pct);
        return `<tr>
          <td style="color:#8290a0;font-size:11px">${sorted.length-i}</td>
          <td><strong style="color:#1b2e42">${escapeHtml(r.name||'â€”')}</strong></td>
          <td style="color:#52677b">${escapeHtml(r.department||'â€”')}</td>
          <td style="color:#52677b">${escapeHtml(r.branch||'â€”')}</td>
          <td style="color:#52677b;font-size:11px">${escapeHtml(r.email||'â€”')}</td>
          <td><div class="score-bar-wrap"><strong style="color:#102943;min-width:28px">${r.score??'â€”'}/${r.scoreOutOf??25}</strong><div class="score-bar-bg"><div class="score-bar-fill" style="width:${barW}%;background:${g.barColor}"></div></div></div></td>
          <td style="font-weight:800;color:${g.barColor}">${pct}%</td>
          <td><span class="grade-pill ${g.cls}">${g.label}</span></td>
          <td style="color:#52677b;white-space:nowrap">${fmtDuration(r.durationSeconds??0)}</td>
          <td style="color:#52677b;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap">${fmtDate(r.completedAt)}</td>
          <td style="font-size:11px;color:#6a7c8e">${escapeHtml(r.status||'â€”')}</td>
        </tr>`;
      }).join('');
    }
    
    $('dash-search').addEventListener('input',()=>{
      const q=$('dash-search').value.toLowerCase();
      const filtered=dashRecords.filter(r=>(r.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)||(r.department||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)||(r.branch||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)||(r.email||'').toLowerCase().includes(q));
      renderTable(filtered);
    });
    
    $('export-btn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
      try{const records=await loadRecords();createXlsx(records);$('admin-status').textContent=`Excel export created â€” ${records.length} submission(s).`;}
      catch(e){console.error(e);$('admin-status').textContent='Could not create the Excel export in this browser.';}
    });

    });

    import { del, get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const PREFIX = 'bankshield/submissions/';
    
    export function validSubmission(r) {
      return r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.submissionId === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(r.submissionId) &&
        ['name', 'department', 'branch', 'email'].every(k => typeof r[k] === 'string' && r[k].trim().length > 0 && r[k].length <= 200) &&
        Number.isInteger(r.score) && r.score >= 0 && r.score <= 25 && Number(r.scoreOutOf) === 25 &&
        Array.isArray(r.responses) && r.responses.length === 25 && r.responses.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    }
    
    export async function saveSubmission(record) {
      await put(`${PREFIX}${record.submissionId}.json`, JSON.stringify(record), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
    }
    
    async function allBlobs() {
      const found = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        found.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      return found;
    }
    
    export async function getSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      return Promise.all(blobs.map(async blob => {
        const file = await get(blob.pathname, { access: 'private' });
        if (!file) return null;
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(file.stream).text());
      })).then(records => records.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt) - new Date(a.completedAt)));
    }
    
    export async function clearSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      if (blobs.length) await del(blobs.map(blob => blob.url));
    }

    import { clearSubmissions, getSubmissions } from '../_lib/submissions.mjs';
    
    export async function GET(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        return json(await getSubmissions());
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export async function DELETE(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        await clearSubmissions();
        return json({ ok: true });
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, DELETE'); }
    export function PUT() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, DELETE'); }
    import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
    import { json } from './http.mjs';
    
    const COOKIE = 'bankshield_admin';
    const SESSION_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60;
    
    function config() {
      const pin = process.env.ADMIN_PIN;
      const secret = process.env.ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET;
      if (!pin || !secret) throw new Error('ADMIN_PIN and ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET must be configured.');
      return { pin, secret };
    }
    
    function signature(expires, secret) {
      return createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`bankshield-admin:${expires}`).digest('base64url');
    }
    
    export async function signIn(request) {
      const { pin, secret } = config();
      let body;
      try { body = await request.json(); }
      catch { return json({ error: 'Invalid JSON.' }, 400); }
      if (typeof body.pin !== 'string' || body.pin !== pin) return json({ error: 'Incorrect administrator PIN.' }, 401);
    
      const expires = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_SECONDS;
      const value = `${expires}.${signature(expires, secret)}`;
      const secure = new URL(request.url).protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '';
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=${value}; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=${SESSION_SECONDS}${secure}`,
      });
    }
    
    export function isAdmin(request) {
      const { secret } = config();
      const cookieHeader = request.headers.get('cookie') || '';
      const raw = cookieHeader.split(';').map(part => part.trim()).find(part => part.startsWith(`${COOKIE}=`))?.slice(COOKIE.length + 1);
      if (!raw) return false;
      const [expiresText, provided] = raw.split('.');
      const expires = Number(expiresText);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expires) || expires <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) || !provided) return false;
      const expected = signature(expires, secret);
      const a = Buffer.from(provided);
      const b = Buffer.from(expected);
      return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
    }
    
    export function unauthorized() {
      return json({ error: 'Administrator sign-in required.' }, 401);
    }
    
    export function signOut() {
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=0`,
      });
    }

    import { errorResponse, methodNotAllowed } from '../_lib/http.mjs';

    export async function POST(request) {
      try { return await signIn(request); }
      catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function GET() { return methodNotAllowed('POST'); }
    import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
    import { json } from './http.mjs';
    
    const COOKIE = 'bankshield_admin';
    const SESSION_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60;
    
    function config() {
      const pin = process.env.ADMIN_PIN;
      const secret = process.env.ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET;
      if (!pin || !secret) throw new Error('ADMIN_PIN and ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET must be configured.');
      return { pin, secret };
    }
    
    function signature(expires, secret) {
      return createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`bankshield-admin:${expires}`).digest('base64url');
    }
    
    export async function signIn(request) {
      const { pin, secret } = config();
      let body;
      try { body = await request.json(); }
      catch { return json({ error: 'Invalid JSON.' }, 400); }
      if (typeof body.pin !== 'string' || body.pin !== pin) return json({ error: 'Incorrect administrator PIN.' }, 401);
    
      const expires = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_SECONDS;
      const value = `${expires}.${signature(expires, secret)}`;
      const secure = new URL(request.url).protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '';
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=${value}; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=${SESSION_SECONDS}${secure}`,
      });
    }
    
    export function isAdmin(request) {
      const { secret } = config();
      const cookieHeader = request.headers.get('cookie') || '';
      const raw = cookieHeader.split(';').map(part => part.trim()).find(part => part.startsWith(`${COOKIE}=`))?.slice(COOKIE.length + 1);
      if (!raw) return false;
      const [expiresText, provided] = raw.split('.');
      const expires = Number(expiresText);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expires) || expires <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) || !provided) return false;
      const expected = signature(expires, secret);
      const a = Buffer.from(provided);
      const b = Buffer.from(expected);
      return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
    }
    
    export function unauthorized() {
      return json({ error: 'Administrator sign-in required.' }, 401);
    }
    
    export function signOut() {
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=0`,
      });
    }
    import { del, get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const PREFIX = 'bankshield/submissions/';
    
    export function validSubmission(r) {
      return r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.submissionId === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(r.submissionId) &&
        ['name', 'department', 'branch', 'email'].every(k => typeof r[k] === 'string' && r[k].trim().length > 0 && r[k].length <= 200) &&
        Number.isInteger(r.score) && r.score >= 0 && r.score <= 25 && Number(r.scoreOutOf) === 25 &&
        Array.isArray(r.responses) && r.responses.length === 25 && r.responses.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    }
    
    export async function saveSubmission(record) {
      await put(`${PREFIX}${record.submissionId}.json`, JSON.stringify(record), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
    }
    
    async function allBlobs() {
      const found = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        found.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      return found;
    }
    
    export async function getSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      return Promise.all(blobs.map(async blob => {
        const file = await get(blob.pathname, { access: 'private' });
        if (!file) return null;
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(file.stream).text());
      })).then(records => records.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt) - new Date(a.completedAt)));
    }
    
    export async function clearSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      if (blobs.length) await del(blobs.map(blob => blob.url));
    }

   ```

2. Install the dependencies and Vercel CLI if needed:

   ```powershell
   npm install
   npx vercel dev
   ```

3. Configure the local environment variables the API needs: `ADMIN_PIN`, `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`, and `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`. You can link the folder to its Vercel project with `npx vercel link`, then use `npx vercel env pull` to load that project’s Development variables. Vercel documents that `vercel dev` uses Development environment variables locally. [Environment variables](https://vercel.com/docs/environment-variables)

4. Open the local address printed by Vercel, then go to `/admin.html`, enter the admin PIN, and click **Review answers** on a candidate row.

**Important:** if you pull the production Blob token, the local dashboard will show production results, and practice submissions may be saved there too. Use a separate development Blob store if you want to test without touching live candidate data. Private Blob access requires the read/write token.     BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:57:function buildAttempt(){let chosen=[];for(const [topic,types] of Object.entries(SLOTS)){const used=new Set();for(const typ of types){const available=QUESTION_BANK.filter(q=>q.topic===topic&&q.type===typ&&!used.has(q.id));if(!available.length)throw new Error('Question pool missing '+topic+' / '+typ);const q=available[Math.floor(Math.random()*available.length)];chosen.push(q);used.add(q.id);}}return randShuffle(chosen);}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:58:function renderTopics(){const counts=[4,4,3,3,3,2,2,2,1,1];const topics=window.bankshieldLanguage?.()==='hi'&&window.__HINDI_TOPICS?window.__HINDI_TOPICS:TOPICS;$('topic-list').innerHTML=topics.map((t,i)=>`<div class="topicrow"><span>${escapeHtml(t)}</span><b>${counts[i]} ${window.bankshieldLanguage?.()==='hi'?window.bankshieldText('dtQuestions','Q'):'Q'}</b><div class="bar"><i style="width:${counts[i]/4*100}%"></i></div></div>`).join('');}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:59:function show(view){['setup-view','quiz-view','finish-view'].forEach(x=>$(x).classList.add('hidden'));$(view).classList.remove('hidden');window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:63:function startTimer(){clearInterval(state.timerId);drawTimer();state.timerId=setInterval(()=>{if(state.submitted)return;state.remaining--;drawTimer();if(state.remaining<=0){clearInterval(state.timerId);submitAssessment(true);}},1000);}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:64:function drawTimer(){const mm=Math.max(0,Math.floor(state.remaining/60)),ss=Math.max(0,state.remaining%60);$('timer').textContent=`${String(mm).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(ss).padStart(2,'0')} ${window.bankshieldText('timerSuffix','remaining')}`;$('timer').classList.toggle('warn',state.remaining<=300&&state.remaining>120);$('timer').classList.toggle('urgent',state.remaining<=120);}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:65:function renderEvidence(q){const root=$('evidence');root.innerHTML='';if(q.type==='diff'&&q.evidence){root.innerHTML=`<div class="evidencegrid">${[[window.bankshieldText('messageA','Message A'),q.evidence.a],[window.bankshieldText('messageB','Message B'),q.evidence.b]].map(([label,obj])=>`<div class="evidencecard"><div class="evidencehead"><span>${label}</span><span>${window.bankshieldText('trainingExample','Training example')}</span></div><div class="evidencebody">${Object.entries(obj).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="evidencerow"><strong>${escapeHtml(window.bankshieldEvidenceLabel(k.replace(/-/g,' ')))}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(v)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;return;}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:66: if(q.evidence&&typeof q.evidence==='object'&&!q.evidence.a){root.innerHTML=`<div class="evidencecard" style="margin-bottom:15px"><div class="evidencehead"><span>${window.bankshieldText('evidenceDetails','Message or situation details')}</span><span>${window.bankshieldText('trainingExample','Training example')}</span></div><div class="evidencebody">${Object.entries(q.evidence).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="evidencerow"><strong>${escapeHtml(window.bankshieldEvidenceLabel(k.replace(/-/g,' ')))}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(v)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;}}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:67:function renderQuestion(){const original=state.questions[state.index];const q=window.localizeQuestion?window.localizeQuestion(original):original;if(!q)return;$('progress-label').textContent=window.bankshieldLanguage?.()==='hi'?`${window.bankshieldText('dtQuestions','Question')} ${state.index+1} / 25`:`Question ${state.index+1} of 25`;$('side-number').textContent=state.index+1;$('progress-fill').style.width=`${(state.index+1)/25*100}%`;$('answered-state').textContent=window.bankshieldText?window.bankshieldText('answeredStateWaiting','Answer before continuing'):'Answer before continuing';$('topic-tag').textContent=q.topic;$('format-tag').textContent=typeLabel(q);$('question-title').textContent=q.prompt;$('question-help').textContent=q.type==='multi'||q.type==='diff'||q.type==='tabletop'?window.bankshieldText('qHelpMulti','Select every answer you think is correct.'):q.type==='order'?window.bankshieldText('qHelpOrder','Drag the step cards into order, from first to last.'):q.type==='match'?window.bankshieldText('qHelpMatch','Drag each answer to the matching item.'):q.type==='branch'?window.bankshieldText('qHelpBranch','This scenario follows up to three decision stages. Your next situation depends on your choice.'):window.bankshieldText('qHelpDefault','Read the situation and choose the safest action.');$('input-error').textContent='';renderEvidence(q);renderInteraction(q);$('continue-btn').textContent=state.index===24?window.bankshieldText('continueBtnSubmit','Submit assessment'):window.bankshieldText('continueBtnNext','Save and continue');$('continue-btn').disabled=false;}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:70: if(['multi','tabletop','diff'].includes(q.type)){h=`<div class="options">${q.options.map((o,i)=>`<button type="button" class="option" data-multi="${i}"><span class="letter">□</span><span>${escapeHtml(o)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><p class="support" style="margin:12px 0 0">${window.bankshieldText('multiHelp','Select all that apply.     function showDpdpImpact(responses){
     const capsByTopic={
      'Customer identity & privacy':250,
      'Phishing & suspicious emails':250,
      'Incident reporting & evidence care':200,
      'Compliance & customer verification':50,
      'Phone calls & social engineering':250,
      'Customer-reported fraud & alerts':50,
      'Email details & header checks':250,
      'Payment instructions & record keeping':50,
      'Branch & physical security':250,
      'Passwords, devices & safe access':250
     };
     const wrong=(responses||[]).filter(r=>!r.correct&&r.candidateAnswer!=='Not answered');
     const totalCrore=wrong.reduce((sum,r)=>sum+(capsByTopic[r.topic]||0),0);
     const panel=$('dpdp-impact');
     panel.dataset.wrongCount=String(wrong.length);
     panel.dataset.exposureCrore=String(totalCrore);
     panel.classList.remove('hidden');
     if(window.bankshieldRefreshLanguage)window.bankshieldRefreshLanguage();
    }

The Act provides maximums of ₹250 crore for failure to take required security safeguards, ₹200 crore for failing to notify a personal data breach, and ₹50 crore for other covered breaches. Actual penalties follow inquiry and depend on the facts. ## Assistant

That message is from the local preview I started. **It serves the pages only; it doesn’t run the API**, so the admin login request fails. I should have made that limitation clearer. Sorry.

For a working local admin login and results dashboard, run the Vercel development server with the project’s API and local environment variables:

1. In PowerShell, open the project folder and run `npm install`.
2. Link the folder to your Vercel project, then pull its **Development** variables: `npx vercel link` and `npx vercel env pull`.
3. Make sure the variables include `ADMIN_PIN`, `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`, and `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`. Don’t paste their values here.
4. Run `npx vercel dev` and open the local address it prints.

Your **deployed** “Server error” is likely a separate configuration issue: the login function requires `ADMIN_PIN` and `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` in Vercel’s project environment variables. Add them in **Project Settings → Environment Variables** for the environment you deployed, then redeploy. The admin dashboard will also need a Blob store connected to the project so `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` is available. If it still fails, check the Vercel Function logs for `/api/admin/login`; they should show the underlying error.

## User

what should be admin session secret?. and from where do i get blob read write token

## Assistant

`ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET` is a **secret key your app uses to sign the admin login cookie**. You create it yourself; it isn’t supplied by Vercel. Use a long, random value—at least 32 characters—and keep it private. In PowerShell, you can generate one with:

```powershell
node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
```

Copy the output into Vercel under **Project → Settings → Environment Variables** as `ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET`. Set `ADMIN_PIN` there too; that’s the PIN you’ll enter on the admin page.

To get `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN`, open your Vercel project’s **Storage** tab, create a **Blob** store, and connect it to the project. Vercel provides the token to the project as an environment variable. Confirm `BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN` is available in the project’s environment variables for the deployment environment, then redeploy. Vercel’s [Blob security docs](https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-blob/security) explain that private Blob operations require this token.

Don’t share either secret in chat or commit them to the codebase.

    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:19: <div class="hero"><div class="eyebrow">Protect customers. Follow the process. Report early.</div><h1>Security awareness for<br>front-line banking staff.</h1><p>This assessment focuses on everyday decisions made by clerks and customer-facing branch staff: checking identity, protecting customer information, spotting suspicious messages, following compliance steps, and reporting concerns without disturbing evidence.</p><div class="pills"><span class="pill">25 questions</span><span class="pill">15-minute limit</span><span class="pill">One question at a time</span><span class="pill">No going back</span><span class="pill">100-question pool</span></div></div>
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:39:   <div class="quiztop"><div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><div class="progresslabel" id="progress-label">Question 1 of 25</div><div class="progressline"><i id="progress-fill"></i></div></div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#738496;white-space:nowrap" id="answered-state">Answer not saved</div></div>
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:43:  <aside class="sidebar"><section class="panel sidepad"><h3>Progress</h3><div class="progressbig"><span id="side-number">1</span><small> / 25</small></div><p>Question order is fixed for this attempt. Earlier questions cannot be reopened.</p></section><section class="panel sidepad"><h3>Time limit</h3><p>15 minutes for the complete assessment. If time runs out, answers already saved will be submitted automatically.</p></section><section class="panel sidepad"><h3>Answer policy</h3><p>Choose carefully. The correct answer and score will not be shown during or after the candidate session.</p></section></aside>
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:50:const QUESTION_BANK=[{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A caller asks for a customer’s account balance. Complete approved identity checks before sharing account information.","id":1,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to send a statement to a new email address. What is the safest action?","options":["Send it and ask them to confirm later","Follow the approved process to verify and update contact details","Send it to both the old and new addresses","Ask a nearby colleague whether the customer seems genuine"],"answer":1,"explanation":"A changed destination must be verified through the bank’s approved process before customer information is sent.","id":2,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague from another department asks for a customer’s phone number but gives no reason. What should you do?","options":["Share it because they work for the bank","Send it through personal chat","Check their work need and access permission first","Read it aloud so it is not written down"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Customer information should only be accessed and shared for an approved work purpose with authorised staff.","id":3,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"You need to discuss a customer complaint at a busy counter. What is best?","options":["Speak loudly so the queue can hear the explanation","Move the discussion to a suitable private place","Use the customer’s full name repeatedly","Ask the next customer to help translate the details"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Discuss personal or account details where other customers cannot overhear them.","id":4,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A printed account statement is left on the shared printer. What should you do?","options":["Leave it in case the owner returns","Put it face down on the counter","Secure it promptly and follow the branch process to notify the owner or report exposure","Take a photo to identify the customer later"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Secure printed customer information promptly and report any possible exposure according to branch procedure.","id":5,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"You see a customer’s account open on a screen while the employee steps away. What is the best response?","options":["Lock the screen if you can do so safely and alert the employee","Read the account to see whether it is important","Leave it because the employee will return","Take a picture as proof"],"answer":0,"explanation":"Screens containing customer data should not be left visible to others. Do not inspect or copy information unnecessarily.","id":6,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose

What should you conclude?","options":["It definitely came from the bank","Ignore it if the message is well written","Treat it cautiously and use the bank’s reporting/verification process","Forward it to the customer for confirmation"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Failed authentication is a warning, not the only factor in a decision. Do not act on the message without verification.","id":63,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"Why can the “Received” lines in an email header be useful?","options":["They may help trained support staff review the route the email took","They show whether a customer has enough money","They guarantee that a sender is honest","They can safely be ignored in every investigation"],"answer":0,"explanation":"Headers can help authorised staff investigate message routing, but they are not proof by themselves.","id":64,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"You are unsure how to view the full email header. What is the safest choice?","options":["Use an unknown online header checker with the whole email","Copy the email to your personal mailbox","Use the bank-approved mail option or ask the service desk for help","Delete the original and keep a screenshot only"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Use approved tools and support routes. Do not upload bank emails or customer data to unapproved websites.","id":65,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"A forwarded email has no clear original sender details. What should you do before acting on a payment request?","options":["Trust the colleague who forwarded it","Ask them to send the original details and verify independently through the known contact route","Click the link to find the original sender","Use the reply button to ask for bank details"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Forwarding can hide or remove context. Verify sensitive requests using original details and a trusted channel.","id":66,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"diff","prompt":"Compare the two header summaries. Header fields alone should be reviewed in context.","id":67,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Spot the difference"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"diff","prompt":"Two messages ask a clerk to review a customer complaint. Select ALL that apply.","options":["Read the full sender address","Check the reply-to and link destination when relevant","Use the approved reporting or verification route","Assume a logo and correct spelling make it safe"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Look at the actual address and destination, then verify or report unusual requests. Appearance alone is not proof.","id":70,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A supplier emails new bank details and asks that today’s payment be made immediately. What should you do?","options":["Change the details based only on the email","Verify the change through the bank’s approved independent process before any update","Reply to the same email asking “Are you sure?”","Ask a colleague to use their login to make the payment"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Payment changes must be independently verified using approved contacts and controls, not only the message that requested the change.","id":71,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to send their account record to a personal email address. What is safest?","options":["Send it if they ask politely","Use a personal email but remove the account number","Follow the bank’s approved document delivery and address-verification process","Ask the customer to sign a blank form first"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Personal email or an unverified destination may not be approved for customer records. Follow the formal process.","id":72,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"You see a mismatch between an invoice amount and the payment record. What should you do?","options":["Change one amount so it matches","Ask the supplier by replying to the same email","Pause the processing step and resolve the mismatch through the approved process","Pay it and make a note later"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Do not guess or quietly alter records. Resolve the mismatch and follow the approved payment process.","id":73,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague asks you to backdate an entry so a missed deadline looks on time. What should you do?","options":["Backdate it if the amount is correct","Make the entry accurate and raise the request through the proper route","Use the date from a similar transaction","Delete the record and start again without telling anyone"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Records must show what actually happened. Never falsify dates or conceal mistakes.","id":74,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A payment request arrives through an unofficial messaging app. What is the best next step?","options":["Process it because the person’s name is familiar","Ask them to send a voice note","Move the request into the bank’s approved workflow and verify it before action","Save the message as proof and pay it"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Use approved channels, verification, and workflow for payment instructions.","id":75,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to correct a transaction note. What should you do?","options":["Change it to what they prefer without checking","Follow the approved correction process and keep an accurate record of the change","Delete the old record","Ask the next shift to handle it without a note"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Corrections should be authorised, traceable, and accurate.","id":76,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A payment instruction has all required fields but comes from a new email address. What should you do?","options":["Proceed because the form is complete","Check the sender and instruction using the required independent verification process","Ask the sender to confirm by replying to the same message","Process it if the amount is small"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Complete fields do not prove that a request is genuine. Follow the established verification checks.","id":77,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"order","prompt":"Put the steps for a supplier bank-detail change in the safest order.","options":["Record the approved change in the official system","Receive an unexpected change request","Verify it independently using a known contact route","Obtain the required approval before making the change"],"answer":[1,2,3,0],"explanation":"Receive the request, verify independently, obtain required approval, then update the official record.","id":78,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Put steps in order"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"multi","prompt":"Which actions help keep payment records safe and accurate? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Use the approved payment workflow","Verify bank-detail changes independently","Keep a clear record of required approvals","Backdate entries when work is delayed"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Approved workflow, independent checks, and traceable approval protect payment records. Do not change history to hide delays.","id":79,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"written","prompt":"Short response: What would you do if a payment request looks genuine but asks for new bank details and an urgent transfer?","sample":"Pause the change, independently verify it through a known contact route, obtain required approval, and record the action in the official workflow.","keywords":["verify","approval","record"],"explanation":"Look for independent verification, required approval, and accurate official recording before processing.","id":80,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Short written response"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"Someone you do not recognise walks behind you through a staff-only door. What should you do?","options":["Leave it for the morning shift","Place it in a secure approved location and report the exposure if required","Take it home so nobody sees it","Put it in ordinary rubbish"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Secure customer paperwork according to the branch process and report possible exposure as required.","id":82,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A visitor asks to borrow your staff badge because they forgot theirs. What is best?","options":["Lend it if they return it quickly","Walk them through the staff entrance","Refuse and direct them to the approved visitor/access process","Let them use your badge only in the lobby"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Never lend staff badges or access credentials.","id":83,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A customer starts reading their account number aloud in a crowded queue. What should you do?","options":["Repeat it loudly to confirm","Help move the discussion to a more private place","Write it on a public board","Ask the queue to move closer"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Protect customer privacy by moving sensitive discussion away from others where possible.","id":84,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"You find a pile of old printouts with customer names beside the printer. What should you do?","options":["Put them in an open tray for the owner","Use the approved secure disposal method or ask the responsible person to handle it","Take them to the break room","Photograph the list before disposing of it"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Customer information must be disposed of using approved secure methods, not ordinary open waste.","id":85,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A stranger says they are here to repair a terminal but has no visible authorisation. What should you do?","options":["Let them start because they sound confident","Ask them for your password first","Follow the visitor/vendor check-in process and confirm authorisation before access","Give them a customer-free workstation"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Vendor work requires the correct authorisation and check-in process before access is provided.","id":86,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"During an evacuation alarm, what should take priority?","options":["Saving paperwork from the desk","Following the branch emergency procedure and moving to safety","Completing the customer queue first","Returning to lock every drawer even if unsafe"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Follow the branch emergency plan and prioritise people’s safety.     export function json(data, status = 200, headers = {}) {
      return Response.json(data, {
        status,
        headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', ...headers },
      });
    }
    
    export async function readJson(request, maxBytes = 1_000_000) {
      const declaredLength = Number(request.headers.get('content-length') || 0);
      if (declaredLength > maxBytes) throw Object.assign(new Error('Request too large.'), { status: 413 });
      const raw = await request.text();
      if (Buffer.byteLength(raw, 'utf8') > maxBytes) throw Object.assign(new Error('Request too large.'), { status: 413 });
      try { return JSON.parse(raw); }
      catch { throw Object.assign(new Error('Invalid JSON.'), { status: 400 }); }
    }
    
    export function errorResponse(error) {
      const status = Number.isInteger(error?.status) ? error.status : 500;
      if (status >= 500) console.error(error);
      return json({ error: status >= 500 ? 'Server error.' : error.message }, status);
    }
    
    export function methodNotAllowed(allow) {
      return json({ error: 'Method not allowed.' }, 405, { Allow: allow });
    }
    import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
    import { json } from './http.mjs';
    
    const COOKIE = 'bankshield_admin';
    const SESSION_SECONDS = 8 * 60 * 60;
    
    function config() {
      const pin = process.env.ADMIN_PIN;
      const secret = process.env.ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET;
      if (!pin || !secret) throw new Error('ADMIN_PIN and ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET must be configured.');
      return { pin, secret };
    }
    
    function signature(expires, secret) {
      return createHmac('sha256', secret).update(`bankshield-admin:${expires}`).digest('base64url');
    }
    
    export async function signIn(request) {
      const { pin, secret } = config();
      let body;
      try { body = await request.json(); }
      catch { return json({ error: 'Invalid JSON.' }, 400); }
      if (typeof body.pin !== 'string' || body.pin !== pin) return json({ error: 'Incorrect administrator PIN.' }, 401);
    
      const expires = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_SECONDS;
      const value = `${expires}.${signature(expires, secret)}`;
      const secure = new URL(request.url).protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '';
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=${value}; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=${SESSION_SECONDS}${secure}`,
      });
    }
    
    export function isAdmin(request) {
      const { secret } = config();
      const cookieHeader = request.headers.get('cookie') || '';
      const raw = cookieHeader.split(';').map(part => part.trim()).find(part => part.startsWith(`${COOKIE}=`))?.slice(COOKIE.length + 1);
      if (!raw) return false;
      const [expiresText, provided] = raw.split('.');
      const expires = Number(expiresText);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expires) || expires <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) || !provided) return false;
      const expected = signature(expires, secret);
      const a = Buffer.from(provided);
      const b = Buffer.from(expected);
      return a.length === b.length && timingSafeEqual(a, b);
    }
    
    export function unauthorized() {
      return json({ error: 'Administrator sign-in required.' }, 401);
    }
    
    export function signOut() {
      return json({ ok: true }, 200, {
        'Set-Cookie': `${COOKIE}=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=0`,
      });
    }

    import { get, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const SETTINGS_PATH = 'bankshield/settings/quiz-config.json';
    export const DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({ questionCount: 25, timeLimitMinutes: 15 });
    export const MAX_QUESTIONS = 97;
    
    function validSettings(value) {
      return value && Number.isInteger(value.questionCount) && value.questionCount >= 5 && value.questionCount <= MAX_QUESTIONS &&
        Number.isInteger(value.timeLimitMinutes) && value.timeLimitMinutes >= 1 && value.timeLimitMinutes <= 180;
    }
    
    export async function readQuizSettings() {
      const blob = await get(SETTINGS_PATH, { access: 'private' });
      if (!blob) return { ...DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS };
      const saved = JSON.parse(await new Response(blob.stream).text());
      if (!validSettings(saved)) throw new Error('Stored quiz settings are invalid.');
      return { questionCount: saved.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: saved.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    export async function writeQuizSettings(value) {
      if (!validSettings(value)) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(`Questions must be 5–${MAX_QUESTIONS}; time must be 1–180 minutes.`), { status: 400 });
      }
      const settings = { questionCount: value.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: value.timeLimitMinutes, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await put(SETTINGS_PATH, JSON.stringify(settings), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
        allowOverwrite: true,
        cacheControlMaxAge: 60,
      });
      return { questionCount: settings.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: settings.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    Add: D:\V1\out\dpl_22VLQcT9vAE63CUH4ga2MU6ryByJ\source\api\admin\settings.mjs
    import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed, readJson } from '../_lib/http.mjs';
    import { isAdmin, unauthorized } from '../_lib/auth.mjs';
    import { MAX_QUESTIONS, readQuizSettings, writeQuizSettings } from '../_lib/quiz-settings.mjs';
    
    export async function GET(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        return json({ ...await readQuizSettings(), maxQuestions: MAX_QUESTIONS });
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export async function PUT(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        const body = await readJson(request);
        return json(await writeQuizSettings({
          questionCount: Number(body?.questionCount),
          timeLimitMinutes: Number(body?.timeLimitMinutes),
        }));
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
