    import { get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
    
    const SETTINGS_PREFIX = 'bankshield/settings/quiz-config-';
    export const DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({ questionCount: 25, timeLimitMinutes: 15 });
    export const MAX_QUESTIONS = 97;
    
    function validSettings(value) {
      return value && Number.isInteger(value.questionCount) && value.questionCount >= 5 && value.questionCount <= MAX_QUESTIONS &&
        Number.isInteger(value.timeLimitMinutes) && value.timeLimitMinutes >= 1 && value.timeLimitMinutes <= 180;
    }
    
    export async function readQuizSettings() {
      let blobs = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: SETTINGS_PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        blobs.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      const latest = blobs.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.uploadedAt) - new Date(a.uploadedAt))[0];
      const blob = latest ? await get(latest.pathname, { access: 'private' }) : null;
      if (!blob) return { ...DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS };
      const saved = JSON.parse(await new Response(blob.stream).text());
      if (!validSettings(saved)) throw new Error('Stored quiz settings are invalid.');
      return { questionCount: saved.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: saved.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    export async function writeQuizSettings(value) {
      if (!validSettings(value)) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(`Questions must be 5â€“${MAX_QUESTIONS}; time must be 1â€“180 minutes.`), { status: 400 });
      }
      const settings = { questionCount: value.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: value.timeLimitMinutes, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await put(`${SETTINGS_PREFIX}${Date.now()}-${randomUUID()}.json`, JSON.stringify(settings), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
      return { questionCount: settings.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: settings.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed } from './_lib/http.mjs';
    import { MAX_QUESTIONS, readQuizSettings } from './_lib/quiz-settings.mjs';
    
    export async function GET() {
      try { return json({ ...await readQuizSettings(), maxQuestions: MAX_QUESTIONS }); }
      catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    export function PUT() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    
    import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed, readJson } from '../_lib/http.mjs';
    import { isAdmin, unauthorized } from '../_lib/auth.mjs';
    import { MAX_QUESTIONS, readQuizSettings, writeQuizSettings } from '../_lib/quiz-settings.mjs';
    
    export async function GET(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        return json({ ...await readQuizSettings(), maxQuestions: MAX_QUESTIONS });
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export async function PUT(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        const body = await readJson(request);
        return json(await writeQuizSettings({
          questionCount: Number(body?.questionCount),
          timeLimitMinutes: Number(body?.timeLimitMinutes),
        }));
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
    
    import { del, get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const PREFIX = 'bankshield/submissions/';
    
    export function validSubmission(r) {
      return r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.submissionId === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(r.submissionId) &&
        ['name', 'department', 'branch', 'email'].every(k => typeof r[k] === 'string' && r[k].trim().length > 0 && r[k].length <= 200) &&
        Number.isInteger(r.score) && r.score >= 0 && Number.isInteger(r.scoreOutOf) && r.scoreOutOf >= 5 && r.scoreOutOf <= 97 && r.score <= r.scoreOutOf &&
        Array.isArray(r.responses) && r.responses.length === r.scoreOutOf && r.responses.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    }
    
    export async function saveSubmission(record) {
      await put(`${PREFIX}${record.submissionId}.json`, JSON.stringify(record), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
    }
    
    async function allBlobs() {
      const found = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        found.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      return found;
    }
    
    export async function getSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      return Promise.all(blobs.map(async blob => {
        const file = await get(blob.pathname, { access: 'private' });
        if (!file) return null;
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(file.stream).text());
      })).then(records => records.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt) - new Date(a.completedAt)));
    }
    
    export async function clearSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      if (blobs.length) await del(blobs.map(blob => blob.url));
    }

    import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed, readJson } from '../_lib/http.mjs';
    import { isAdmin, unauthorized } from '../_lib/auth.mjs';
    import { MAX_QUESTIONS, readQuizSettings, writeQuizSettings } from '../_lib/quiz-settings.mjs';
    
    export async function GET(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        return json({ ...await readQuizSettings(), maxQuestions: MAX_QUESTIONS });
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export async function PUT(request) {
      try {
        if (!isAdmin(request)) return unauthorized();
        const body = await readJson(request);
        return json(await writeQuizSettings({
          questionCount: Number(body?.questionCount),
          timeLimitMinutes: Number(body?.timeLimitMinutes),
        }));
      } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
    }
    
    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('GET, PUT'); }
    
    import { del, get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const PREFIX = 'bankshield/submissions/';
    
    export function validSubmission(r) {
      return r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.submissionId === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(r.submissionId) &&
        ['name', 'department', 'branch', 'email'].every(k => typeof r[k] === 'string' && r[k].trim().length > 0 && r[k].length <= 200) &&
        Number.isInteger(r.score) && r.score >= 0 && Number.isInteger(r.scoreOutOf) && r.scoreOutOf >= 5 && r.scoreOutOf <= 97 && r.score <= r.scoreOutOf &&
        Array.isArray(r.responses) && r.responses.length === r.scoreOutOf && r.responses.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    }
    
    export async function saveSubmission(record) {
      await put(`${PREFIX}${record.submissionId}.json`, JSON.stringify(record), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
    }
    
    async function allBlobs() {
      const found = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        found.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      return found;
    }
    
    export async function getSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      return Promise.all(blobs.map(async blob => {
        const file = await get(blob.pathname, { access: 'private' });
        if (!file) return null;
        return JSON.parse(await new Response(file.stream).text());
      })).then(records => records.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.completedAt) - new Date(a.completedAt)));
    }
    
    export async function clearSubmissions() {
      const blobs = await allBlobs();
      if (blobs.length) await del(blobs.map(blob => blob.url));
    }

The quiz now has editable settings in the admin dashboard: **5–97 questions** and a **1–180 minute** time limit. Settings are saved in private Vercel Blob storage, with defaults of 25 questions and 15 minutes.

The candidate page fetches the latest settings when opened and refreshes them again when the candidate starts. So a settings change made while someone has the link open applies when they press **Start**; a quiz already underway keeps the settings it started with. I updated the timer, question count, progress display, and submission validation to support different quiz lengths.

This change requires a new Vercel deployment. I didn’t deploy or run tests. Vercel’s Blob SDK supports private storage and versioned files; the settings use a new versioned file for each save. [Vercel Blob SDK](https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-blob/using-blob-sdk)

## Assistant

On Vercel’s free Hobby plan, Blob includes **1 GB/month of storage**, **10 GB/month of data transfer**, and **2,000 advanced operations/month**. The limits are shared across Blob use in the project. [Vercel Blob pricing and limits](https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-blob/usage-and-pricing)

Each quiz result is one JSON file with candidate details and per-question answers. A rough estimate is **10–30 KB for a 25-question test**, or **30–100 KB near the 97-question maximum**. So 1 GB could hold tens of thousands of typical 25-question results, depending on answer lengths.

For this app, though, the **operation limit is likely to matter first**: each completed test currently makes two settings-list calls and one result upload—about three advanced operations. That works out to roughly **650 completed tests per month** under the free limit, before other Blob activity. The Vercel dashboard’s Blob usage view will show the actual usage.

One additional consideration: Vercel says Hobby is for personal, non-commercial use. Since this quiz is for a bank event, check that the plan is appropriate for your use. [Vercel Hobby plan](https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby)

One caveat: on the free Hobby plan, Vercel can pause deployments if usage limits are exceeded. Your quiz also depends on Blob for settings and results, so hitting Blob limits could disrupt those functions. For the bank event, check the project’s usage before the session and confirm the plan suits business use; Vercel describes Hobby as for personal, non-commercial projects.     import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed } from './_lib/http.mjs';
    import { MAX_QUESTIONS, readQuizSettings } from './_lib/quiz-settings.mjs';
    
    export async function GET() {
      try { return json({ ...await readQuizSettings(), maxQuestions: MAX_QUESTIONS }); }
      catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }

    export function POST() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    export function PUT() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('GET'); }
    
    import { get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
    
    const SETTINGS_PREFIX = 'bankshield/settings/quiz-config-';
    export const DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({ questionCount: 25, timeLimitMinutes: 15 });
    export const MAX_QUESTIONS = 97;
    
    function validSettings(value) {
      return value && Number.isInteger(value.questionCount) && value.questionCount >= 5 && value.questionCount <= MAX_QUESTIONS &&
        Number.isInteger(value.timeLimitMinutes) && value.timeLimitMinutes >= 1 && value.timeLimitMinutes <= 180;
    }
    
    export async function readQuizSettings() {
      let blobs = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: SETTINGS_PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        blobs.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      const latest = blobs.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.uploadedAt) - new Date(a.uploadedAt))[0];
      const blob = latest ? await get(latest.pathname, { access: 'private' }) : null;
      if (!blob) return { ...DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS };
      const saved = JSON.parse(await new Response(blob.stream).text());
      if (!validSettings(saved)) throw new Error('Stored quiz settings are invalid.');
      return { questionCount: saved.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: saved.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    export async function writeQuizSettings(value) {
      if (!validSettings(value)) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(`Questions must be 5â€“${MAX_QUESTIONS}; time must be 1â€“180 minutes.`), { status: 400 });
      }
      const settings = { questionCount: value.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: value.timeLimitMinutes, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await put(`${SETTINGS_PREFIX}${Date.now()}-${randomUUID()}.json`, JSON.stringify(settings), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
      return { questionCount: settings.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: settings.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    import { errorResponse, json, methodNotAllowed, readJson } from './_lib/http.mjs';
    import { saveSubmission, validSubmission } from './_lib/submissions.mjs';
    
    export async function POST(request) {
      try {
        const record = await readJson(request);
        if (!validSubmission(record)) return json({ error: 'Submission is incomplete or invalid.' }, 400);
        await saveSubmission(record);
        return json({ ok: true }, 201);
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.status) return errorResponse(error);
        if (error?.statusCode === 409 || error?.code === 'BLOB_ALREADY_EXISTS') return json({ error: 'This submission was already recorded.' }, 409);
        return errorResponse(error);
      }
    }
    
    export function GET() { return methodNotAllowed('POST'); }
    export function PUT() { return methodNotAllowed('POST'); }
    export function DELETE() { return methodNotAllowed('POST'); }

For a **single auditorium event with roughly 100–300 candidates**, the current free-tier limits look adequate. I can’t guarantee there will be no outage, but normal use at that size is unlikely to hit the monthly limits.

The main constraint is Vercel Blob: Hobby includes **1 GB storage, 10,000 simple operations, 2,000 advanced operations, and 10 GB of data transfer**. In this quiz, each candidate who completes the test triggers about **three advanced operations**: two settings lookups and one saved result. That makes the rough ceiling **about 660 completed tests per month**, before admin activity or other Blob use. citeturn9search1

The other concern is a burst of candidates starting at once. Blob Hobby allows **900 advanced operations per minute**; since opening and starting each test each look up settings, a very large group doing both in the same minute could hit that rate limit. If a limit is exceeded, Vercel says Blob access is unavailable until the limit resets, so saving results or loading settings could fail. citeturn9search1

Vercel Hobby also includes **1 million function invocations**, which is unlikely to be the first limit for one quiz event. citeturn9search0

For a larger group, check **Vercel Dashboard → Blob → Usage** before the event, and run a rehearsal with several devices.     BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:55:let quizSettings={questionCount:25,timeLimitMinutes:15,maxQuestions:QUESTION_BANK.length};
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:59:function allocateTopicCounts(total){const weights=[4,4,3,3,3,2,2,2,1,1],counts=Array(TOPICS.length).fill(0),pools=TOPICS.map(topic=>QUESTION_BANK.filter(q=>q.topic===topic));for(let n=0;n<total;n++){let pick=-1,priority=-1;TOPICS.forEach((_,i)=>{if(counts[i]<pools[i].length&&weights[i]/(counts[i]+1)>priority){pick=i;priority=weights[i]/(counts[i]+1);}});if(pick<0)break;counts[pick]++;}return counts;}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:60:function buildAttempt(questionCount){const quotas=allocateTopicCounts(questionCount),chosen=[];TOPICS.forEach((topic,i)=>{const pool=randShuffle(QUESTION_BANK.filter(q=>q.topic===topic));chosen.push(...pool.slice(0,quotas[i]));});if(chosen.length!==questionCount)throw new Error('The question pool cannot fill the configured assessment.');return randShuffle(chosen);}
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:78: if(q.type==='written'||q.type==='correction'){root.innerHTML=`<label for="short-response" class="support">${window.bankshieldText('writtenHelp','Write a brief answer in plain language. Do not include real customer information.')}</label><textarea id="short-response" class="shortbox" maxlength="1200" placeholder="${window.bankshieldText('writtenPh','Type your response here')}"></textarea><p class="support" style="margin:8px 0 0">${window.bankshieldText('writtenFoot','Written answers are stored for administrator review.')}</p>`;return;}

        const fs = require('fs');
        const file = 'BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html';
        let s = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
        const m = s.match(/const QUESTION_BANK=(\[.*?\]);/s);
        if (!m) throw new Error('Question bank not found');
        const bank = JSON.parse(m[1]);
        const objective = bank.filter(q => q.type !== 'written' && q.type !== 'correction');
        if (bank.length !== 97 || objective.length !== 93) throw new Error(`Unexpected pool sizes ${bank.length}/${objective.length}`);
        s = s.replace(m[0], `const QUESTION_BANK=${JSON.stringify(objective)};`);
        s = s.replaceAll('97-question pool', '93-question pool');
        fs.writeFileSync(file, s, 'utf8');
        '@ | node

    admin.html:8:</head><body><header class="topbar"><div class="brand"><div class="mark">B</div><div>BankShield<small>Administrator portal</small></div></div><div class="topnote">Shared server submissions</div></header><main class="wrap"><section class="panel panel-pad adminbox"><div class="admin-header-row"><div><div class="kicker">Administrator</div><h2 style="margin:4px 0 2px">Admin Dashboard</h2><p class="muted" style="margin:0">Unlock to review candidate answers, scores, and export submissions.</p></div><div class="admin-lock-row"><input id="admin-pin" type="password" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Enter admin PIN" aria-label="Administrator PIN" style="border:1px solid #d5e0e9;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;width:200px;font:inherit;outline:none"><button class="btn primary" id="admin-unlock-btn" type="button">Unlock</button></div></div><p class="tiny" id="admin-status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top:8px">Enter the administrator PIN configured on the server.</p><div id="admin-dashboard" class="hidden"><div class="dash-stats" id="dash-stats"></div><section class="settings-panel"><div><div class="kicker">Quiz setup</div><h3>Assessment settings</h3><p>New settings apply when a candidate starts the quiz.</p></div><form id="quiz-settings-form"><label>Questions <input id="setting-question-count" name="questionCount" type="number" min="5" max="93" required></label><label>Time limit (minutes) <input id="setting-time-limit" name="timeLimitMinutes" type="number" min="1" max="180" required></label><button class="btn primary" id="save-settings-btn" type="submit">Save settings</button><span id="settings-status" class="tiny" aria-live="polite"></span></form></section><div class="dash-toolbar"><input id="dash-search" type="search" placeholder="Search by name, branch, department..." class="dash-search-input"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn secondary" id="export-btn" type="button">Export Excel</button><button class="btn danger" id="clear-btn" type="button">Clear records</button></div></div><div class="dash-table-wrap"><table class="dash-table" id="dash-table"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Name</th><th>Department</th><th>Branch</th><th>Email</th><th>Score</th><th>%</th><th>Grade</th><th>Duration</th><th>Submitted</th><th>Status</th><th>Assessment</th></tr></thead><tbody id="dash-tbody"></tbody></table><p id="dash-empty" class="dash-empty hidden">No submissions found on this server.</p></div></div></section><dialog class="review-dialog" id="review-dialog" aria-labelledby="review-title"><div class="review-head"><div><div class="kicker">Candidate assessment</div><h2 id="review-title">Question by question review</h2><div class="review-meta" id="review-meta"></div></div><button class="review-close" id="review-close" type="button">Close</button></div><div class="review-content" id="review-content"></div></dialog></main><script>
    admin.html:23:function createXlsx(records){const attempts=[['Submission ID','Started at (UTC)','Submitted at (UTC)','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Score (admin only)','Out of','Percentage (admin only)','Duration (seconds)','Submission status','Questions answered']];const details=[['Submission ID','Name','Department','Branch','Work email','Submitted at (UTC)','Question #','Pool ID','Topic','Question type','Question','Candidate response','Correct answer (admin only)','Auto-graded correct?','Written response needs manual review?','Explanation (admin only)']];for(const r of records){attempts.push([r.submissionId,r.startedAt,r.completedAt,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.score,r.scoreOutOf,r.percent,r.durationSeconds,r.status,r.responses.filter(x=>x.candidateAnswer!=='Not answered').length]);for(const d of r.responses)details.push([r.submissionId,r.name,r.department,r.branch,r.email,r.completedAt,d.questionNumber,d.questionId,d.topic,d.type,d.prompt,d.candidateAnswer,d.correctAnswer,d.correct?'Yes':'No',d.writtenNeedsReview?'Yes':'No',d.explanation]);}
    admin.html:24: const notes=[['BankShield assessment results â€” administrator workbook'],['Purpose','Stores candidate details, internal scores, and per-question answer records for submissions saved on this server.'],['Data scope','This export includes all submissions saved on this server. All attempts submitted to this server are included.'],['Scoring note','Written-response and error-correction answers use basic keyword checks only. Review those responses manually before making decisions.'],['Privacy note','This workbook contains employee identifiers and assessment answers. Store and share it only through approved bank channels.'],['Security note','Static HTML is a pilot. The answer key is present in the page source; this design hides it from the candidate interface but is not a secure proctored testing platform.'],['Empty export','If there are no rows on the Attempts sheet, no attempts have been stored on this server.']];
    admin.html:137:    return `<article class="response-card ${correct?'correct':'incorrect'}"><div class="response-status ${correct?'correct':'incorrect'}">Question ${Number(item.questionNumber)||index+1} Â· ${correct?'Correct':'Incorrect'}</div><h3>${escapeHtml(item.prompt||'Question text unavailable')}</h3><div class="response-answer"><strong>Candidate answer:</strong> ${escapeHtml(item.candidateAnswer||'Not answered')}</div><div class="response-answer"><strong>Expected answer:</strong> ${escapeHtml(item.correctAnswer||'Not available')}</div>${item.explanation?`<div class="response-answer"><strong>Explanation:</strong> ${escapeHtml(item.explanation)}</div>`:''}${item.writtenNeedsReview?'<div class="response-answer"><strong>Review note:</strong> Written answer should be checked manually.</div>':''}</article>`;

    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:19: <div class="hero"><div class="eyebrow">Protect customers. Follow the process. Report early.</div><h1>Security awareness for<br>front-line banking staff.</h1><p>This assessment focuses on everyday decisions made by clerks and customer-facing branch staff: checking identity, protecting customer information, spotting suspicious messages, following compliance steps, and reporting concerns without disturbing evidence.</p><div class="pills"><span class="pill" id="question-count-pill">25 questions</span><span class="pill" id="time-limit-pill">15-minute limit</span><span class="pill">One question at a time</span><span class="pill">No going back</span><span class="pill" id="question-pool-pill">93-question pool</span></div></div>
    BankShield_Frontline_Assessment.html:50:const QUESTION_BANK=[{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A caller asks for a customer’s account balance. What should you do first?","options":["Confirm identity using the bank’s approved checks","Share it if the caller knows the customer’s full name","Ask the caller to send an email request","Give only an approximate balance"],"answer":0,"explanation":"A name or other personal detail is not enough. Complete approved identity checks before sharing account information.","id":1,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to send a statement to a new email address. What is the safest action?","options":["Send it and ask them to confirm later","Follow the approved process to verify and update contact details","Send it to both the old and new addresses","Ask a nearby colleague whether the customer seems genuine"],"answer":1,"explanation":"A changed destination must be verified through the bank’s approved process before customer information is sent.","id":2,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague from another department asks for a customer’s phone number but gives no reason. What should you do?","options":["Share it because they work for the bank","Send it through personal chat","Check their work need and access permission first","Read it aloud so it is not written down"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Customer information should only be accessed and shared for an approved work purpose with authorised staff.","id":3,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"You need to discuss a customer complaint at a busy counter. What is best?","options":["Speak loudly so the queue can hear the explanation","Move the discussion to a suitable private place","Use the customer’s full name repeatedly","Ask the next customer to help translate the details"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Discuss personal or account details where other customers cannot overhear them.","id":4,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"A printed account statement is left on the shared printer. What should you do?","options":["Leave it in case the owner returns","Put it face down on the counter","Secure it promptly and follow the branch process to notify the owner or report exposure","Take a photo to identify the customer later"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Secure printed customer information promptly and report any possible exposure according to branch procedure.","id":5,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"single","prompt":"You see a customer’s account open on a screen while the employee steps away. What is the best response?","options":["Lock the screen if you can do so safely and alert the employee","Read the account to see whether it is important","Leave it because the employee will return","Take a picture as proof"],"answer":0,"explanation":"Screens containing customer data should not be left visible to others. Do not inspect or copy information unnecessarily.","id":6,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer identity & privacy","type":"multi","prompt":"Before sharing customer information with another employee, which checks should you make? Select ALL that apply.","options":["They have an approved
    ... command output truncated for persistence ...
    rovals should be treated as a potential compromise and escalated promptly.","id":56,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Customer-reported fraud & alerts","type":"order","prompt":"A customer reports possible online banking fraud. Put the actions in the best order.","options":["Record the key facts accurately using the bank’s process","Listen calmly and identify the concern","Follow the official fraud escalation and customer guidance process","Do not ask for or record passwords, PINs, or OTPs"],"answer":[1,3,0,2],"explanation":"Listen, avoid collecting secrets, document the relevant facts, then follow the official fraud process.","id":57,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Put steps in order"},{"topic":"Customer-reported fraud & alerts","type":"multi","prompt":"A customer reports a possible scam. Which details are useful to record under the bank’s process? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Approximate time and what happened","Contact number or message details, where permitted by policy","What action the customer says they took","The customer’s full password or OTP"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Record relevant facts and preserve relevant messages as directed, but never ask for or record secrets such as passwords, PINs, or OTPs.","id":59,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Customer-reported fraud & alerts","type":"tabletop","prompt":"Mini tabletop: a customer says they followed a caller’s instructions, installed a remote-access app, and then saw a debit alert. Select ALL suitable actions for a front-desk employee.","options":["Stay calm, record the customer’s report, and escalate through the official fraud route","Tell the customer to contact the bank using a verified official channel","Ask for their banking password to confirm the transaction","Tell them to delete the app and all messages before reporting","Follow the bank’s process for urgent fraud concerns and instructions"],"answer":[0,1,4],"explanation":"Front-line staff should collect relevant facts, avoid secrets or improvised technical support, and promptly use the official fraud route.","id":60,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Mini tabletop"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"In an email, the visible sender name says “Customer Support,” but the address is helpdesk@bank-account-check.example. What does that suggest?","options":["The display name proves it is genuine","The address is worth checking because the sender name can be faked","All email addresses ending in .example are safe","It is safe if the email has a logo"],"answer":1,"explanation":"The full sender address matters; a display name and logo can be copied.","id":61,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"An email’s “Reply-To” address differs from the “From” address. What should you do?","options":["Treat it as a warning sign and verify the request before replying or acting","Ignore the difference every time","Send a test password to check it","Assume the email is genuine if it arrived in a known thread"],"answer":0,"explanation":"A different reply-to address may be legitimate, but it needs checking when unexpected or linked to sensitive requests.","id":62,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"A mail security result says an email authentication check failed. What should you conclude?","options":["It definitely came from the bank","Ignore it if the message is well written","Treat it cautiously and use the bank’s reporting/verification process","Forward it to the customer for confirmation"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Failed authentication is a warning, not the only factor in a decision. Do not act on the message without verification.","id":63,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"Why can the “Received” lines in an email header be useful?","options":["They may help trained support staff review the route the email took","They show whether a customer has enough money","They guarantee that a sender is honest","They can safely be ignored in every investigation"],"answer":0,"explanation":"Headers can help authorised staff investigate message routing, but they are not proof by themselves.","id":64,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"You are unsure how to view the full email header. What is the safest choice?","options":["Use an unknown online header checker with the whole email","Copy the email to your personal mailbox","Use the bank-approved mail option or ask the service desk for help","Delete the original and keep a screenshot only"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Use approved tools and support routes. Do not upload bank emails or customer data to unapproved websites.","id":65,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"single","prompt":"A forwarded email has no clear original sender details. What should you do before acting on a payment request?","options":["Trust the colleague who forwarded it","Ask them to send the original details and verify independently through the known contact route","Click the link to find the original sender","Use the reply button to ask for bank details"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Forwarding can hide or remove context. Verify sensitive requests using original details and a trusted channel.","id":66,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"diff","prompt":"Compare the two header summaries. Select ALL items that make Message B more suspicious.","evidence":{"a":{"from":"alerts@bank.example","reply-to":"alerts@bank.example","auth-result":"PASS (training example)","subject":"Monthly statement ready"},"b":{"from":"alerts@bank-notice.example","reply-to":"confirm-login@fast-mail.example","auth-result":"FAIL (training example)","subject":"URGENT: verify password within 5 minutes"}},"options":["The sender domain is not the known bank domain","The reply-to points to a different unfamiliar address","The authentication result is shown as failed","The message subject says “statement”"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Sender and reply-to differences plus failed authentication and pressure deserve verification. Header fields alone should be reviewed in context.","id":67,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Spot the difference"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"diff","prompt":"Two messages ask a clerk to review a customer complaint. Select ALL differences that should trigger extra checks in Message B.","evidence":{"a":{"from":"complaints@bank.example","link":"https://staff.bank.example/case/123","request":"Review the case in the normal work system","tone":"No unusual urgency"},"b":{"from":"complaints@bank-casework.example","link":"http://bank-case-review.example/signin","request":"Enter staff password and send a screenshot of the customer record","tone":"Do this secretly before your manager returns"}},"options":["Different, lookalike sender domain","Unfamiliar sign-in destination","Request to send customer data and keep it secret","Both messages refer to a complaint"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"The unfamiliar sender/link, request for customer data, and secrecy are meaningful warning signs.","id":68,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Spot the difference"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"match","prompt":"Match each email detail to what it can tell you.","left":["From / sender address","Reply-To address","Received header lines"],"right":["May help authorised staff review the route a message took","Shows where replies may go","Shows the address claiming to have sent the message"],"answer":[2,1,0],"explanation":"Email details can provide clues but need to be reviewed carefully and through approved tools.","id":69,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Match the columns"},{"topic":"Email details & header checks","type":"multi","prompt":"Before acting on an unusual email, which checks can help? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Read the full sender address","Check the reply-to and link destination when relevant","Use the approved reporting or verification route","Assume a logo and correct spelling make it safe"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Look at the actual address and destination, then verify or report unusual requests. Appearance alone is not proof.","id":70,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A supplier emails new bank details and asks that today’s payment be made immediately. What should you do?","options":["Change the details based only on the email","Verify the change through the bank’s approved independent process before any update","Reply to the same email asking “Are you sure?”","Ask a colleague to use their login to make the payment"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Payment changes must be independently verified using approved contacts and controls, not only the message that requested the change.","id":71,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to send their account record to a personal email address. What is safest?","options":["Send it if they ask politely","Use a personal email but remove the account number","Follow the bank’s approved document delivery and address-verification process","Ask the customer to sign a blank form first"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Personal email or an unverified destination may not be approved for customer records. Follow the formal process.","id":72,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"You see a mismatch between an invoice amount and the payment record. What should you do?","options":["Change one amount so it matches","Ask the supplier by replying to the same email","Pause the processing step and resolve the mismatch through the approved process","Pay it and make a note later"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Do not guess or quietly alter records. Resolve the mismatch and follow the approved payment process.","id":73,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague asks you to backdate an entry so a missed deadline looks on time. What should you do?","options":["Backdate it if the amount is correct","Make the entry accurate and raise the request through the proper route","Use the date from a similar transaction","Delete the record and start again without telling anyone"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Records must show what actually happened. Never falsify dates or conceal mistakes.","id":74,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A payment request arrives through an unofficial messaging app. What is the best next step?","options":["Process it because the person’s name is familiar","Ask them to send a voice note","Move the request into the bank’s approved workflow and verify it before action","Save the message as proof and pay it"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Use approved channels, verification, and workflow for payment instructions.","id":75,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A customer asks you to correct a transaction note. What should you do?","options":["Change it to what they prefer without checking","Follow the approved correction process and keep an accurate record of the change","Delete the old record","Ask the next shift to handle it without a note"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Corrections should be authorised, traceable, and accurate.","id":76,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"single","prompt":"A payment instruction has all required fields but comes from a new email address. What should you do?","options":["Proceed because the form is complete","Check the sender and instruction using the required independent verification process","Ask the sender to confirm by replying to the same message","Process it if the amount is small"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Complete fields do not prove that a request is genuine. Follow the established verification checks.","id":77,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"order","prompt":"Put the steps for a supplier bank-detail change in the safest order.","options":["Record the approved change in the official system","Receive an unexpected change request","Verify it independently using a known contact route","Obtain the required approval before making the change"],"answer":[1,2,3,0],"explanation":"Receive the request, verify independently, obtain required approval, then update the official record.","id":78,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Put steps in order"},{"topic":"Payment instructions & record keeping","type":"multi","prompt":"Which actions help keep payment records safe and accurate? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Use the approved payment workflow","Verify bank-detail changes independently","Keep a clear record of required approvals","Backdate entries when work is delayed"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Approved workflow, independent checks, and traceable approval protect payment records. Do not change history to hide delays.","id":79,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"Someone you do not recognise walks behind you through a staff-only door. What should you do?","options":["Assume a customer service employee invited them","Follow branch access/visitor procedure and alert the appropriate staff or security contact","Give them your access card","Ignore it if they carry a laptop"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Restricted areas require authorised access. Do not lend credentials or assume someone else checked.","id":81,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A document containing customer details is left on the counter after closing. What should you do?","options":["Leave it for the morning shift","Place it in a secure approved location and report the exposure if required","Take it home so nobody sees it","Put it in ordinary rubbish"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Secure customer paperwork according to the branch process and report possible exposure as required.","id":82,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A visitor asks to borrow your staff badge because they forgot theirs. What is best?","options":["Lend it if they return it quickly","Walk them through the staff entrance","Refuse and direct them to the approved visitor/access process","Let them use your badge only in the lobby"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Never lend staff badges or access credentials.","id":83,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A customer starts reading their account number aloud in a crowded queue. What should you do?","options":["Repeat it loudly to confirm","Help move the discussion to a more private place","Write it on a public board","Ask the queue to move closer"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Protect customer privacy by moving sensitive discussion away from others where possible.","id":84,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"You find a pile of old printouts with customer names beside the printer. What should you do?","options":["Put them in an open tray for the owner","Use the approved secure disposal method or ask the responsible person to handle it","Take them to the break room","Photograph the list before disposing of it"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Customer information must be disposed of using approved secure methods, not ordinary open waste.","id":85,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"A stranger says they are here to repair a terminal but has no visible authorisation. What should you do?","options":["Let them start because they sound confident","Ask them for your password first","Follow the visitor/vendor check-in process and confirm authorisation before access","Give them a customer-free workstation"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Vendor work requires the correct authorisation and check-in process before access is provided.","id":86,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"During an evacuation alarm, what should take priority?","options":["Saving paperwork from the desk","Following the branch emergency procedure and moving to safety","Completing the customer queue first","Returning to lock every drawer even if unsafe"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Follow the branch emergency plan and prioritise people’s safety. Do not delay evacuation to protect records.","id":87,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"single","prompt":"You notice a public noticeboard has a sheet with staff phone numbers and shift details. What should you do?","options":["Leave it because staff information is not customer data","Take it down if authorised and report it through the appropriate branch process","Post a photo in the staff group","Add more details so it is clearer"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Staffing and contact information can create security risks. Follow the branch process to secure and report it.","id":88,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"multi","prompt":"Which actions help keep a branch secure? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Challenge or report unauthorised access using branch procedure","Keep customer papers and screens away from public view","Use the approved visitor/vendor check-in process","Lend your badge to someone who forgot theirs"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Access controls, privacy and visitor checks help protect the branch. Do not lend badges.","id":89,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"},{"topic":"Branch & physical security","type":"order","prompt":"Put these steps for an unknown visitor requesting access to a staff-only area in order.","options":["Confirm their visit/authorisation through the approved process","Do not let them enter using your badge","Direct them to the authorised reception or visitor procedure","Notify the appropriate branch/security contact if the request remains suspicious"],"answer":[1,2,0,3],"explanation":"Do not allow unauthorised entry; direct the visitor to the correct process, verify permission, and escalate any concern.","id":90,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Put steps in order"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague asks to use your login because theirs is not working. What should you do?","options":["Share it for one task","Type the password for them and let them continue under your name","Do not share it; direct them to the approved access-help process","Create a simple shared password for the team"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Each person must use their own approved account. Shared logins make actions hard to trace.","id":91,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"You receive an MFA approval prompt but are not trying to sign in. What should you do?","options":["Approve it to clear the alert","Deny or ignore it as appropriate and report it through the bank’s approved process","Send a screenshot of the prompt to a friend","Keep approving until it stops"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Unexpected sign-in prompts may indicate someone has your password. Do not approve them; report promptly.","id":92,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"You need to leave your desk briefly while the customer system is open. What should you do?","options":["Lock the screen before stepping away","Minimise the window only","Ask a customer to watch the screen","Leave it open because you will be quick"],"answer":0,"explanation":"Lock the screen when you leave, even briefly.","id":93,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"A pop-up says you must install a new “security tool” from an unfamiliar website to continue work. What is best?","options":["Install it if the pop-up uses the bank logo","Ask a colleague to download it instead","Do not install it; check with the approved IT/service desk route","Use your personal laptop to install and transfer it"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Only use software and installation processes approved by the bank.","id":94,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"You find an unknown USB device beside the teller counter. What should you do?","options":["Plug it in to identify the owner","Take it to an approved contact without connecting it to any device","Use it only on a spare workstation","Give it to a customer who asks about it"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Do not connect unknown devices to bank systems. Follow the branch process for handling found property.","id":95,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"A password reset email arrives that you did not request. What should you do?","options":["Use the link to see which account it affects","Ignore it and approve any follow-up prompts","Do not use unexpected links; report or verify through the approved channel","Forward it to your personal email for later"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Unrequested reset emails can indicate someone is trying to access the account. Use approved verification/reporting.","id":96,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"You need to access bank systems while travelling. Which option is safest?","options":["Use any public computer available","Use only the bank-approved device and access method","Ask a hotel worker to log in for you","Use a stranger’s Wi-Fi and save your password"],"answer":1,"explanation":"Use only approved devices, connections and access methods for bank work.","id":97,"difficulty":"Basic","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"single","prompt":"A colleague has written their password on a sticky note near the monitor. What should you do?","options":["Copy it in case they forget","Leave it visible because it is their account","Alert the colleague and follow the bank’s process to correct the unsafe practice","Use it only if they are on leave"],"answer":2,"explanation":"Passwords should not be left visible. Help correct the practice and report repeated or serious issues according to policy.","id":98,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Choose one"},{"topic":"Passwords, devices & safe access","type":"multi","prompt":"Which are safe account and device habits? Select ALL that apply.","options":["Use your own account and do not share passwords","Lock the screen when leaving the desk","Report unexpected sign-in or password-reset prompts","Approve an MFA prompt you did not start"],"answer":[0,1,2],"explanation":"Use individual accounts, lock the screen, and report unexpected prompts. Never approve a sign-in you did not initiate.","id":99,"difficulty":"Intermediate","points":1,"formatLabel":"Select all that apply"}];

    import { get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
    
    const SETTINGS_PREFIX = 'bankshield/settings/quiz-config-';
    export const DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS = Object.freeze({ questionCount: 25, timeLimitMinutes: 15 });
    export const MAX_QUESTIONS = 93;
    
    function validSettings(value) {
      return value && Number.isInteger(value.questionCount) && value.questionCount >= 5 && value.questionCount <= MAX_QUESTIONS &&
        Number.isInteger(value.timeLimitMinutes) && value.timeLimitMinutes >= 1 && value.timeLimitMinutes <= 180;
    }
    
    export async function readQuizSettings() {
      let blobs = [];
      let cursor;
      do {
        const page = await list({ prefix: SETTINGS_PREFIX, limit: 1000, cursor });
        blobs.push(...page.blobs);
        cursor = page.hasMore ? page.cursor : undefined;
      } while (cursor);
      const latest = blobs.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.uploadedAt) - new Date(a.uploadedAt))[0];
      const blob = latest ? await get(latest.pathname, { access: 'private' }) : null;
      if (!blob) return { ...DEFAULT_QUIZ_SETTINGS };
      const saved = JSON.parse(await new Response(blob.stream).text());
      // Clamp settings saved before subjective questions were removed.
      if (!saved || !Number.isInteger(saved.questionCount) || saved.questionCount < 5 ||
          !Number.isInteger(saved.timeLimitMinutes) || saved.timeLimitMinutes < 1 || saved.timeLimitMinutes > 180) {
        throw new Error('Stored quiz settings are invalid.');
      }
      return { questionCount: Math.min(saved.questionCount, MAX_QUESTIONS), timeLimitMinutes: saved.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    export async function writeQuizSettings(value) {
      if (!validSettings(value)) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(`Questions must be 5â€“${MAX_QUESTIONS}; time must be 1â€“180 minutes.`), { status: 400 });
      }
      const settings = { questionCount: value.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: value.timeLimitMinutes, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await put(`${SETTINGS_PREFIX}${Date.now()}-${randomUUID()}.json`, JSON.stringify(settings), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
      return { questionCount: settings.questionCount, timeLimitMinutes: settings.timeLimitMinutes };
    }
    
    import { del, get, list, put } from '@vercel/blob';
    
    const PREFIX = 'bankshield/submissions/';
    
    export function validSubmission(r) {
      return r && typeof r === 'object' && typeof r.submissionId === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(r.submissionId) &&
        ['name', 'department', 'branch', 'email'].every(k => typeof r[k] === 'string' && r[k].trim().length > 0 && r[k].length <= 200) &&
        Number.isInteger(r.score) && r.score >= 0 && Number.isInteger(r.scoreOutOf) && r.scoreOutOf >= 5 && r.scoreOutOf <= 93 && r.score <= r.scoreOutOf &&
        Array.isArray(r.responses) && r.responses.length === r.scoreOutOf && r.responses.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object');
    }
    
    export async function saveSubmission(record) {
      await put(`${PREFIX}${record.submissionId}.json`, JSON.stringify(record), {
        access: 'private',
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        addRandomSuffix: false,
      });
    }
